commands.command:
install -d -m 0700 -o root -g root /var/backups/inventory; cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory
date_stamp=$(/usr/bin/date +%F)
final_archive="$backup_dir/inventory-$date_stamp.tar.gz"
tmp_tar=$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$backup_dir/.inventory-$date_stamp.XXXXXX.tar")
tmp_gz="$tmp_tar.gz"
cleanup() {
    /usr/bin/rm -f "$tmp_tar" "$tmp_gz"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
/usr/bin/ssh \
    -o BatchMode=yes \
    -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts \
    -i /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519 \
    root@10.100.240.11 > "$tmp_tar"
/usr/bin/tar -tf "$tmp_tar" >/dev/null
/usr/bin/gzip -9 "$tmp_tar"
/usr/bin/mv -f "$tmp_gz" "$final_archive"
/usr/bin/find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete
trap - EXIT
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup; cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Back up node2 inventory data to node1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/var/backups/inventory

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Nightly inventory backup at 02:00

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true
Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
restorecon -F /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup /var/backups/inventory /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl daemon-reload; systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer; systemctl enable --now inventory-backup.timer; printf 'TIMER_ENABLED='; systemctl is-enabled inventory-backup.timer; printf 'TIMER_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active inventory-backup.timer; systemctl list-timers inventory-backup.timer --all --no-pager
